author: GitHub
description:
Agent sessions shouldn't be locked into a single code editor or terminal window. Patrick Nikoletich explains how GitHub's shared agent runtime, Copilot SDK, and Agent Host Protocol let developers move active sessions seamlessly across multiple devices. Watch a live demonstration of hosting an agent on a home Linux machine, connecting via Copilot CLI, and syncing real-time updates across multiple clients.
